trace_name: Appendicectomy: pelvic appendix, delivered out of the pelvis

description: [t=0s] m0.4: Administer the single preoperative broad-spectrum antibiotic dose within the prophylaxis window before incision
[t=60s] m0.1: Review imaging and laboratory results; confirm the diagnosis of acute appendicitis and the indication for appendicectomy
[t=120s] m0.2: Confirm consent and operative plan, including anticipation of appendiceal position variants and the possibility of conversion
[t=180s] m0.3: Confirm team, resource tier and equipment plan for the case
[t=240s] m0.5: Apply venous thromboembolism prophylaxis per protocol
[t=300s] m0.6: Position the patient supine with arms tucked; displays positioned for access to the right iliac fossa
[t=360s] m0.7: Equipment check: laparoscope and camera, insufflator, suction, energy source, endoloop/stapler availability
[t=420s] m0.8: WHO Sign In completed before induction of anaesthesia
[t=1500s] m0.9: WHO Time Out completed before skin incision
[t=1800s] m1.1: Infraumbilical skin incision
[t=1860s] m1.2: Establish pneumoperitoneum and insert the 10-12 mm umbilical camera port by open cutdown; insufflation pressure at or below 15 mmHg
[t=1920s] m1.3: Place the 5 mm suprapubic midline port under direct vision, taking care to avoid the bladder
[t=1980s] m1.4: Place the 5 mm left-lower-quadrant port under direct vision
[t=2040s] m2.1: Inspect the abdomen; confirm appendicitis as the etiology and exclude other pathology
[t=2100s] m2.2: Identify the cecum by its taeniae and paler colour against the small bowel; identify the terminal ileum
[t=2160s] m2.3: Grade the appendicitis intra-operatively (WSES grading) and state the severity the operation will be conducted for
[t=2220s] dp1 -> grade-uncomplicated
[t=2280s] m2.4: Note any free fluid or pus and aspirate it for inspection; record its character (serous, purulent, faeculent)
[t=2340s] m2.5: Position the patient Trendelenburg with the right side up; retract small bowel out of the right iliac fossa
[t=2400s] m3.1: Follow the taeniae coli along the cecum to their convergence at the cecal pole
[t=2460s] m3.2: Demonstrate the appendix arising from the convergence, below the ileocaecal junction
[t=2520s] m3.3: Assess and state the condition of the appendiceal base: healthy, inflamed or necrotic
[t=2520s] Appendiceal base identification achieved: all three criteria demonstrated
[t=2580s] m3.7: Deliver the pelvic appendix up out of the pelvis into view (pelvic configuration)
[t=2640s] m3.4: Identify the appendiceal artery within the mesoappendix
[t=2640s] Appendiceal base identification achieved: all three criteria demonstrated
[t=2700s] m4.1: Second look: confirm the identified structure is the appendix at its base - not cecal wall - before proceeding
[t=2760s] m4.2: Pre-division pause: the identified base, the artery plan and the closure plan are verbalised and confirmed with the team before any clip is applied
[t=2820s] m5.1: Create the window in the mesoappendix at the appendiceal base, skeletonising it
[t=2880s] m5.2: Clip the appendiceal artery
[t=2880s] Appendiceal base identification achieved: all three criteria demonstrated
[t=2940s] m5.3: Divide the mesoappendix
[t=3000s] m6.1: Re-state the base condition and select the closure method against it
[t=3060s] dp3 -> endoloop
[t=3120s] m6.2: Apply endoloop ligation at the appendiceal base (simple ligation; no stump inversion)
[t=3180s] m6.5: Divide the appendix immediately above the closure
[t=3240s] m6.6: Inspect the stump: closure seated on viable tissue, no leak, haemostasis at the mesoappendix stump
[t=3300s] m7.1: Place the appendix in a specimen retrieval bag
[t=3360s] m7.4: Inspect the stump, the cecum and the mesoappendix for integrity and haemostasis
[t=3420s] m8.1: Extract the bagged specimen via the umbilical port
plus: Appendiceal base positively identified and demonstrated before any clip or division — taeniae traced to their convergence, appendix seen arising from it, base condition stated (T19, T14).
Pre-division pause performed and the identification confirmed with the team before clipping (module safety culture, T20).
All three WHO checklist phases were completed at their integration points (T6).
directive: Maintain the sequence discipline shown here; the next training increment is speed under the same gate discipline, not a relaxation of it.
summary: Verdict: PASS (formative only — no construct evidence exists for these scores yet).
Checklist 100.0% (38/38), safety gate 4/4, process 5/5, physiology 7/7, management n/a (no complication).
